# Edutools iOS launch-screen assets

This asset catalog belongs to the Flutter iOS runner. It supplies the launch-screen images used while Flutter starts, rather than the Android launcher icon or the in-app logo.

Replace the images while retaining the filenames referenced by `Contents.json`, or open `ios/Runner.xcworkspace` in Xcode and edit the Runner asset catalog. Check the result on supported iOS device sizes.

The distributed release is currently the Android APK. See the [project README](../../../../README.md) for features, development setup, and release downloads.
